item: Shifted target tree S+ with charging of fresh splits (Mézard-Parisi lower bound): delay every internal branching depth of the target shape by one, so each target branching vertex must be created by a fresh unary split (coefficient -delta), giving sum |c| <= C delta^b and, after division by J = kappa(S+)^2 ~ delta^{2b}, a relative absolute cost bounded uniformly in L
item_type: lemma (F3; device inside the conditional-decorrelation induction)
lean_status_why: Located: the shift is OAI/Probability/DilutedSpin/ShiftedTree.lean (bottomUnary, doubled, shiftedTwinDepths, shifted_twin_old_count/target_count), the charging lemma is ShapeCharging.lean:30 prescribed_history_charging_bound (via HistorySelector.lean:155 labeledHistory_charging_bound and ActualCharging.lean chargeBound), and the relative bound after division is RootMatrixTriple.lean:110 shiftedCharge_relative_bound; all lie on the proof path of the comparator target OAI.DilutedSpinGlass.mezard_parisi.
lean_gaps: Text-level only: the Lean was NOT compiled (no local toolchain). The DAG was regenerated with scripts/extract_lean.py into the scratchpad because data/items/221_lean.json is an older v1 extraction without dominated_share; data/items was not modified.

Encoding of the shift: the Lean works with two aligned copies, doubled S = node 2 (fun _ => S), compared with doubled (bottomUnary S) (old tree: depths unchanged) and doubled (unary S) (target: every branching depth delayed). Because doubled adds a root level, the charged depth set is shiftedTwinDepths S = branchingDepths S + 2, and with a retained prefix shiftedPrefixDepths S d = (+2) + d. This is the paper's S+ (shift by one) seen from inside the doubled tree.

The general-position premise is made explicit as NoAdjacentBranchDepths S (no two branching depths differ by 1), derived from regularity once eta L > 1; the paper says 'for large L, regularity ensures that each shifted depth differs from every branching depth of the old tree'.

Charging constant: the paper bounds the sum by k!/(k-b)! (q+k)^b (2(q+k))^{k-b} delta^b; the Lean uses a recursively defined chargeBound C D k b (chargeBound_scale pulls out delta^b with delta = 1/L). Equivalent role, different constant bookkeeping.

Normalizer: the paper divides by J = kappa(S+)^2; the Lean divides by |partialKappa T grid univ / partialKappa T grid {b,a}| (a full-to-protected-pair kappa ratio, protectedKappa_grid_lower gives D*E <= J) and states the cancellation of powers of L exactly, including distinct vertices at equal depths (docstring of shiftedCharge_relative_bound).

The Lean's lower bound (symmetric_trial_lower, SymmetricTrialLower.lean:13) is stated for Model (q+1) of ANY arity with a permutation-symmetric bounded-first-moment disorder; the paper fixes even p in model.tex:3 (the even-arity/positivity class is needed only for the upper bound). So the Lean lower bound containing the device is more general than the paper's stated scope, and the SATComputability formalization (docs/235) (SATComputability) uses it at arity 3.

The charging count (without the shift) is used a second time inside the family: qExpect_grid_branching (QTreeLaw.lean:112) bounds the Q_k random-tree mass of prescribed branching vertices by chargeBound * L^{-b}; it matches the paper's separate Lemma tree:regular-shapes (trees.tex:468), whose proof is the probabilistic version of the same count. This reuses the fresh-split count, not the S+ shift.

Comparator is the full headline (pressure -> variationalValue for admissible models); the device is invisible in statements. Declaration-level dominated shares are small (prescribed_history_charging_bound 0.0014, shiftedCharge_relative_bound 0.0032, node_frame_charge_uniform 0.0115); the novelty pass's 0.80/0.67 were file-import shares and are inflated.

lean_source.name: bottomUnary
lean_source.text:
/-- Extending the final unary edge keeps every internal branching depth.
In contrast, `unary S` delays all of them by exactly one. -/
def bottomUnary : {n : ℕ} → PrescribedTree n → PrescribedTree (n+1)
  | 0, .leaf => unary .leaf
  | _+1, .node k C => .node k (fun i => bottomUnary (C i))

lean_source.name: doubled
lean_source.text:
/-- Both copies are aligned, but the two occurrences are different vertices. -/
def doubled {n : ℕ} (S : PrescribedTree n) : PrescribedTree (n+1) := .node 2 (fun _ => S)

lean_source.name: shiftedTwinDepths
lean_source.text:
noncomputable def shiftedTwinDepths {n : ℕ} (S : PrescribedTree n) : Finset ℕ :=
  (branchingDepths S).image (fun d => d+2)

lean_source.name: NoAdjacentBranchDepths
lean_source.text:
/-- Regular depth assignments imply this no-adjacent-depth condition once
eta L > 1. It is precisely the geometric premise of shifted charging. -/
def NoAdjacentBranchDepths {n : ℕ} (S : PrescribedTree n) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ branchingDepths S, ∀ b ∈ branchingDepths S, a+1 ≠ b

lean_source.name: shifted_twin_old_count
lean_source.text:
lemma shifted_twin_old_count {n : ℕ} (S : PrescribedTree n) (hs : NoAdjacentBranchDepths S) :
    branchingCount (doubled (bottomUnary S)) (· ∈ shiftedTwinDepths S) = 0

lean_source.name: shifted_twin_target_count
lean_source.text:
lemma shifted_twin_target_count {n : ℕ} (S : PrescribedTree n) :
    branchingCount (doubled (unary S)) (· ∈ shiftedTwinDepths S) =
      2*branchingCount S (fun _ => True)

lean_source.name: chargeBound
lean_source.text:
noncomputable def chargeBound (C D : ℝ) : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ
  | 0, b => if b = 0 then 1 else 0
  | k+1, 0 => C * chargeBound C D k 0
  | k+1, b+1 => C * chargeBound C D k (b+1) + D * chargeBound C D k b

lean_source.name: labeledHistory_charging_bound
lean_source.text:
/-- Charging estimate for an actual labeled terminal observable. Restricting
the allowed splitting matrices and inserting a uniformly bounded projection
error are both handled in this single estimate. -/
theorem labeledHistory_charging_bound (hL : 0 < L) (Q : Finset ℕ) (b : ℕ)
    (V : (S : PrescribedTree L) → (C → S.Leaf) → (Sample Ω S → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (E : ℝ) (hE : 0 ≤ E) (cs : List C) (S : PrescribedTree L)
    (U : Finset ι) (loc : ι → S.Leaf) (pos : C → S.Leaf)
    (f : Sample Ω S → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ 1) (hU : U.card ≤ leaves S)
    (hV : ∀ T pos g, (∀ x, |g x| ≤ 1) → |V T pos g| ≤ E *
      (if branchingCount S (· ∈ Q)+b ≤ branchingCount T (· ∈ Q) then 1 else 0)) :
    |labeledHistory (grid L 0 L) V cs S U loc pos f| ≤
      E * (chargeBound (2*(leaves S+cs.length:ℕ)) ((Q.card:ℝ)*(leaves S+cs.length:ℕ))
        cs.length b * (L:ℝ)⁻¹^b)

lean_source.name: prescribed_history_charging_bound
lean_source.text:
/-- Absolute projection-error cost for the ACTUAL exact-matrix history. This
is the charging step in the shifted-two-copy argument: take Q to be shifted
depths, so the old tree has no branching in Q. The exponent counts vertices,
not distinct depths, hence aligned copies are charged separately. -/
theorem prescribed_history_charging_bound (hL : 0 < L) (Q : Finset ℕ)
    (T S : PrescribedTree L) (q : C → T.Leaf) (hq : Function.Surjective q)
    (hS : branchingCount S (· ∈ Q) = 0)
    (W : (R : PrescribedTree L) → (C → R.Leaf) → (Sample Ω R → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (E : ℝ) (hE : 0 ≤ E)
    (hW : ∀ R pos g, (∀ x, |g x| ≤ 1) →
      (∀ a b, splitDepth R (pos a) (pos b) = splitDepth T (q a) (q b)) → |W R pos g| ≤ E)
    (cs : List C) (U : Finset ι) (loc : ι → S.Leaf) (pos : C → S.Leaf)
    (f : Sample Ω S → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, |f x| ≤ 1) (hU : U.card ≤ leaves S) :
    |labeledHistory (grid L 0 L)
      (fun R pos g => if ∀ a b, splitDepth R (pos a) (pos b) = splitDepth T (q a) (q b)
        then W R pos g else 0) cs S U loc pos f| ≤
      E * (chargeBound (2*(leaves S+cs.length:ℕ)) ((Q.card:ℝ)*(leaves S+cs.length:ℕ))
        cs.length (branchingCount T (· ∈ Q)) * (L:ℝ)⁻¹^(branchingCount T (· ∈ Q)))

lean_source.name: shiftedCharge
lean_source.text:
noncomputable def shiftedCharge (Q : Finset ℕ) (T S : PrescribedTree L) (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  chargeBound (2*(leaves S+k:ℕ)) ((Q.card:ℝ)*(leaves S+k:ℕ)) k (branchingCount T (· ∈ Q)) *
    (L:ℝ)⁻¹^(branchingCount T (· ∈ Q))

lean_source.name: shiftedCharge_relative_bound
lean_source.text:
/-- The manuscript's relative absolute-cost bound. Its dimensional power of
L cancels EXACTLY, including distinct target vertices sharing a depth. -/
theorem shiftedCharge_relative_bound (hL : 0 < L) (Q : Finset ℕ)
    (T S : PrescribedTree L) (k : ℕ) (a b : T.Leaf) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (hr : BranchRegular T (grid L 0 L) η)
    (hb : branchingCount T (fun _ => True) = branchingCount T (· ∈ Q)+1) :
    shiftedCharge Q T S k /
        |partialKappa T (grid L 0 L) Finset.univ / partialKappa T (grid L 0 L) {b,a}| ≤
      chargeBound (2*(leaves S+k:ℕ)) ((Q.card:ℝ)*(leaves S+k:ℕ)) k
        (branchingCount T (· ∈ Q)) / η^(branchExcess T)

lean_source.name: shiftedPrefixDepths
lean_source.text:
/-- Charged depths after retaining the genuine shared prefix above d. -/
noncomputable def shiftedPrefixDepths (S : PrescribedTree n) (d : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (shiftedTwinDepths S).image (fun u => u+d)

lean_source.name: qExpect_grid_branching
lean_source.text:
lemma qExpect_grid_branching {L : ℕ} (hL : 0<L) (Q : Finset ℕ) (k b : ℕ)
    (S : PrescribedTree L) :
    qExpect (grid L 0 L) (fun T => if branchingCount S (·∈Q)+b≤branchingCount T (·∈Q)
      then 1 else 0) k S≤
    chargeBound (2*(leaves S+k:ℕ)) ((Q.card:ℝ)*(leaves S+k:ℕ)) k b * (L:ℝ)⁻¹^b

lean_source.name: symmetric_trial_lower
lean_source.text:
lemma symmetric_trial_lower {q : ℕ} (M : Model (q+1)) (hα : 0 < M.alpha)
    (hθ : Integrable (fun z : InteractionSample (q+1) => ‖z.1‖) M.disorder.toMeasure)
    (hh : Integrable (fun h : ℝ => |h|) M.field.toMeasure)
    (hsym : ∀ e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (q+1)),IdentDistrib (fun z : InteractionSample (q+1) => z.1)
      (fun z : InteractionSample (q+1) => fun s => z.1 (fun i => s (e i))) M.disorder.toMeasure M.disorder.toMeasure)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (ζ : Hierarchy (r+1)) (m : Fin r → ℝ),Exponents m ∧
      functional M r ζ m ≤ liminf (pressure M) atTop+ε

Whether this shortens Panchenko's structural statement (which is about limits of Gibbs measures) is unclear; it shortens the route to the free-energy consequence, which is a corollary of 221.
